Bank-Math-Master.question: ১) If x = √3 + √2 ,then x + (1/x) = ?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: If x = √3 + √2 , x + (1/x) = ?

সমাধান:
দেওয়া আছে,
x = √3 + √2
এখন, 1/x = 1/(√3 + √2)
= (√3 - √2)/(√3 + √2) (√3 - √2)
= (√3 - √2)/(3 - 2)
∴ 1/x = √3 - √2

x + 1/x = √3 + √2 + √3 - √2
= 2√3

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২) If a certain coin is flipped, the probability that the coin will land heads is 1/2. If the coin is flipped 3 times, what is the probability that it will land heads up on the first 2 flips and not on the last flip?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If a certain coin is flipped, the probability that the coin will land heads is 1/2. If the coin is flipped 3 times, what is the probability that it will land heads up on the first 2 flips and not on the last flip?

Solution: 
The probability of landing heads and not landing on heads is the same = 1/2
The probability of first two heads =(1/2) × (1/2)
The probability of the last  landing not on heads = 1/2
The total probability =(1/2) × (1/2) × (1/2) 
= 1/ 23
= 1/8

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৫) What is the solution of x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + 6 < 0?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: What is the solution of x2 - 5x + 6 < 0? 
 
Solution: 
x2 - 5x + 6 < 0
⇒ (x - 2)(x - 3) < 0

The inequality will be true if x - 2 > 0 and x - 3 < 0.
x - 2 > 0
⇒ x > 2

x - 3 < 0
⇒ x < 3

The inequality will be true if  2 < x < 3.
The solution of the inequality is 2 < x < 3

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৭) What is the solution of the inequality ।5x - 3। < 4?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: What is the solution of the inequality ।5x - 3। < 4?

Solution: 
।5x - 3। < 4
⇒ - 4 < 5x - 3 < 4
⇒  - 4  + 3 < 5x - 3 + 3 < 4 + 3
⇒ - 1 < 5x < 7
⇒ - 1/5 < 5x/5 < 7/5
⇒ - 1/5 < x < 7/5

Bank-Math-Master.question: ৮) If x<sup>4</sup> - x<sup>2</sup> + 1 = 0, then x<sup>3</sup> + 1/x<sup>3</sup> =?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: If x4 - x2 + 1 = 0, then x3 + 1/x3 =?

সমাধান:
x4 - x2 + 1 = 0
⇒ x4 + 1 = x2
⇒ x4/x2 + 1/x2 = x2/x2
⇒ x2  + 1/x2 = 1
⇒ (x + 1/x)2 - 2.x.1/x = 1
⇒ (x + 1/x)2 - 2 = 1
⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = 1 + 2
⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = 3
⇒ (x + 1/x) = √3

x3 + 1/x3 =(x + 1/x)3 - 3.x.1/x(x + 1/x)
= (√3)3 - 3√3
= 3√3  - 3√3
= 0

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৪) Average of 60 numbers are 42. When 5 more numbers are included, the average of 65 numbers become 45. Find the average of 5 numbers.
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: Average of 60 numbers are 42. When 5 more numbers are included, the average of 65 numbers become 45. Find the average of 5 numbers.

Solution:
Total of 60 numbers = 60 × 42 = 2520
Now, total of 65 numbers = 65 × 45 = 2925

Hence, sum of 5 numbers = 2925 - 2520 = 405

∴ Average of five numbers = 405/5
 = 81

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৫) In a simultaneous throw of two dice, what is the probability of getting a doublet?

Question: In a simultaneous throw of two dice, what is the probability of getting a doublet?

Solution:

= ৩৬ টি

= ৬ টি 

∴ সম্ভাবনা = ৬/৩৬

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৬) The average of 6 numbers is 7. The average of three numbers of them is 5. What will be the average of the remaining numbers?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: The average of 6 numbers is 7. The average of three numbers of them is 5. What will be the average of the remaining numbers?

Solution:
Average of 6 numbers = 7
Sum of 6 numbers = 6 × 7 = 42
Average of three numbers = 5
Sum of three numbers = 5 × 3 = 15

∴ Sum of the remaining three numbers = 42 - 15 = 27

∴ Required average = 27/3 = 9

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৭) If x + 4/x = 4, then x/(x<sup>2</sup> + x - 1) =?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
প্রশ্ন: If x + 4/x = 4, then x/(x2 + x - 1) =?

সমাধান:
দেওয়া আছে
x + 4/x = 4
⇒ (x2 + 4)/x = 4
⇒ x2 + 4 = 4x
⇒ x2 - 4x + 4 = 0
⇒ (x - 2)2 = 0
⇒ x - 2 = 0
⇒ x = 2

প্রদত্ত রাশি
x/(x2 + x - 1)
= 2(22 + 2 - 1)
= 2/(4 + 2 - 1)
= 2/5

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৮) What is the probability of getting 53 Tuesdays in a leap year?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: What is the probability of getting 53 Tuesdays in a leap year?

Solution: 
1 year = 365 days . A leap year has 366 days
A year has 52 weeks. Hence there will be 52 Tuesdays for sure.
52 weeks = 52 x 7 = 364 days
366 – 364 = 2 days

In a leap year there will be 52 Tuesdays and 2 days will be left.

These 2 days can be:
1. Sunday, Monday
2. Monday, Tuesday
3. Tuesday, Wednesday
4. Wednesday, Thursday
5. Thursday, Friday
6. Friday, Saturday
7. Saturday, Sunday

Of these total 7 outcomes, the favourable outcomes are 2.

Hence, the probability of getting 53 days = 2/7

Bank-Math-Master.question: ১৯) If x : y = 15 : 4 then the value of (x - y)/(x + y) is-
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If x : y = 15 : 4 then the value of (x - y)/(x + y) is- 

Solution: 
x : y = 15 : 4
⇒ x/y = 15/4
⇒ (x + y)/(x - y) = (4 + 15)/(15 - 4)
⇒ (x + y)/(x - y) = 19/11
⇒ (x - y)/(x + y) = 11/19

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২২) If a + b = 1 and a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + 3ab = k, then the value of k is?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If a + b = 1 and a3 + b3 + 3ab = k, then the value of k is?

Solution: 
a3 + b3 + 3ab = k
⇒ (a + b)3 - 3ab (a + b) + 3ab = k 
⇒ 13 - 3ab × 1 + 3ab = k
⇒ k = 1 - 3ab + 3ab = 1

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২৩) In an examination, 80% of candidates passed in English, and 85% of candidates passed in Mathematics. If 73% of candidates passed in both these subjects, then what percent of candidates failed in both subjects?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: In an examination, 80% of candidates passed in English, and 85% of candidates passed in Mathematics. If 73% of candidates passed in both these subjects, then what percent of candidates failed in both subjects?

Solution: 
Students passed in English = 80%
Students passed in Math = 85%
Students passed in both subjects = 73%
Then, the number of students who passed in at least one subject
= (80 + 85) - 73
= 92%

Thus, students failed in both subjects = 100 - 92
= 8%

Bank-Math-Master.question: ২৫) If a<sup>3</sup> - b<sup>3</sup> = 56 and a - b = 2, then the value of a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> =?
Bank-Math-Master.exp:
Question: If a3 - b3 = 56 and a - b = 2, then the value of a2 + b2 =? 

Solution: 
a3 - b3 = 56
⇒ (a - b) (a2 + ab + b2) = 56
⇒ a2 + ab + b2 = 56/2 = 28
⇒ (a - b)2 + 3ab = 28 
⇒ 3ab = 28 - 4 = 24 
⇒ ab = 24/3 = 8

a2 + ab + b2 = 28
⇒ a2 + b2 = 28 - 8 = 20
